summary: Advertising packages. Migration 0025 adds ad_plan and ad_subscription, the ADVERTISING_PACKAGE payment service and the ADVERTISING settings group. The base profile stays free and is not a row: a record with no live subscription simply has none. The catalogue is the six plans of §14 — featured and pro over 30, 90 and 365 days — and each plan stores only the key of its price in product_setting, so a price is one audited settings edit and past purchases keep the amount they froze. All six prices are seeded NOT_CONFIGURED because no real tariff exists in the sources: an unpriced plan is refused rather than sold for nothing. A purchase is an ordinary Phase 1 payment batch that snapshots the managed price; the package is activated inside the very transaction that verifies the gateway on the server, and a replayed return activates nothing a second time. There is no scheduler: expiry is ends_at compared at read time, and an expired row keeps its stored status while readers simply stop treating it as live. Renewing early stacks rather than discarding paid days — the new period starts where the live one ends, and the earlier row stays in the history. Each plan carries a slot capacity that refuses the next sale when it is full, an empty capacity meaning no ceiling was recorded rather than a decision to sell without limit. Only the manager of a claimed record buys (a veterinarian profile, a centre, an association or a club); an unowned record and every operational context are refused. Cancelling keeps the dates and the reason, and no refund rule was invented. The package is its own axis: it changes placement and the «تبلیغ» label only, and the service merely reports which records are promoted — the versioned, auditable search ranking of §15 stays with its own prompt.

limitations: Every package price is NOT_CONFIGURED on purpose: no real tariff exists in the sources, so no plan can be sold until the product owner enters the figures in /admin/settings.
Discounts are named by §14 but no discount rule exists in the sources; adding one would invent pricing policy, so it is left to the admin panel of PROMPT-016.
No refund rule: cancelling keeps the paid period with its reason, and money already taken is settled outside the product until a policy exists.

The advertising ranking of §15 is not built here: the service only reports which records carry a live package; ordering search results with the «تبلیغ» label, versioned and auditable, belongs to the search/ranking prompt.
No invoice or formal receipt document; the record of a purchase is the Phase 1 payment batch.
Browser and unit/DB checks were targeted by user instruction; unaffected suites were last run in full at commit 7c74577.
Visual fidelity of the packages and catalogue pages is UNVERIFIED: no Phase 2 Figma frame is in the sources.
